Runs journalctl --output=json, the newest entries last: the last 100 unless lines says, of one unit when unit says, since a time when since says, and at a priority or above when priority says. A priority is its name, such as err or info. The hand-written log domain read the Debian family only; this reads each Linux host that has journald.
